brief:
# Artemis approved facts — settle the 40 items left for the owner

An earlier AI pass left these fact candidates for the owner because the page did not settle them. The owner has now delegated them: "전부 다 해결해줘" (2026-10-28), with the standing rule "매뉴얼을 기준으로 판단해서 결정짓자" (the 2026-10-19 manual governs; a statute that differs is recorded, not followed). Your decisions become "AI-confirmed (owner-delegated)" facts, kept apart from human-approved ones and used only to send answers to review, never to withhold. A wrong fact can flag a right answer, so confirm only what the page text supports.

Read only `packet.json` in this directory and write only `decisions.json` there.

For every item (`earlier` holds the previous AI's guess and the owner question):
- `confirm` when the page lets you state who it applies to, the role and the value. Rules for the recurring cases:
  - "(참고) 2025년 기준" or similar on a table in this 2026 manual: the manual prints these as its reference values, so confirm them as the manual's values and put the note in `subject.qualifiers.column_label` or `reason` (e.g. "매뉴얼 표기 2025년 기준").
  - A flattened table (cells run together on one line): confirm only if you can tell for certain which row and column each number belongs to from the text around it; otherwise reject.
  - No status code on the page: confirm only if the page's own title or a heading on the page names the chapter's status; otherwise reject.
- `reject` when it is not a rule-level fact or you cannot pin its subject, role or value from the page.

Output `decisions.json`: an array in packet order of
`{"candidate_id", "final": "confirm"|"reject", "subject": {"status_code", "sub_code", "procedure": "visa"|"stay", "qualifiers": {"applicant", "household_size", "per", "nationality", "row_label", "column_label"}} or null, "role": one of roles or null, "value": {"kind", "amount", "unit", "comparator"} or null, "reason": "Korean, 1–2 sentences"}`.
`procedure` is "visa" for a visa_issuance page and "stay" for a stay page. The amount must appear in the item's `quote` (digits without commas; 억/만/천; "N년 M개월" as months). Self-check with `python3 -I` and report: counts of confirm/reject, the self-check result, two example reasons.
